description: Local decision models for AI agents: classify, route and score with a probability per option. Python client, systemone-compatible local server, MCP tools and a Claude Code guard.
rules: Install a backend extra: pip install "jev-style[mlx]" on Apple silicon, or "jev-style[torch]" for CPU, CUDA and images; the bare package is only the client.
Start the local server with jev-style serve (http://127.0.0.1:8765); --release 2b selects Jev-Style-2B-Decision-v4.
Requests use POST /v1/systemone with a state and typed questions (noul, choice, score); every option gets a probability.
Images need 2B v4 on the PyTorch backend; MLX and GGUF builds are text-only.
Choose acceptance thresholds on held-out examples and keep a fallback for uncertain or failed requests.
